d: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps or the IRGC has opened an exhibition in Tehran showcasing Iran's ballistic missiles, cruise missiles and drones. The IRGC Aerospace Force is in-charge of the museum and has put captured and destroyed American and Israeli weapons on display, which has become a highlight for Iranian people. Among the captured American weapons on display is what looks like the MQ-1, the RQ-170 Sentinel and the RQ-4 Global Hawk.
